tools.name: add_target
tools.description: Adds an imaging target to the end of the advanced sequence's target area. Two ways, pass exactly one: (1) 'template': a saved target template (list_target_templates) whose target name and coordinates are replaced; the template's own instructions are used and the plan options below are not allowed. (2) 'exposures': an exposure plan; pins builds the target from standard instructions in this order: slew and center with plate solving (slew_and_center, default true), autofocus (autofocus_at_start, default false), start guiding (start_guiding, default true), then one exposure block per entry (filter, exposure, count, gain/offset/binning, dithering every dither_every frames). Coordinates are J2000. Only edits the sequence (nothing moves); check the result with get_sequence, then start_sequence. Adding while the sequence runs needs force.
